scope: Characterize bounded decoded SAB transform-record shapes in rooted projection without choosing a matrix convention or applying placement.

apiBehavior: Exactly twelve finite numeric values retain the profile-specific ParsedUnapplied state and twelve serialized candidates.
A bounded thirteen-number literal, three-or-more structured coordinate-vector tokens, or bounded non-literal transform token record is reported as UnsupportedVariant rather than malformed.
Numeric literal classification scans at most thirteen finite values in one pass; the alternate thirteenth value is not retained as a matrix component.
Empty transform records, truncated or malformed numeric literals, non-finite values, and values beyond the characterized thirteen-number form remain Invalid.
UnsupportedVariant is appended to the public enum so existing enumerator values remain unchanged.
All tokens, literal candidate text, source token index, and hint order remain preserved; no transform, placement, unit scaling, or WCS interpretation occurs.
Existing extraction-work and token/string/output resource accounting remains in force.
testCoverage: Generated twelve-number candidate with asymmetric values remains ParsedUnapplied.
Generated thirteen-number literal is retained as UnsupportedVariant without candidate components.
Generated triplet-plus-scalar record with trailing LiteralStr hint retains vector values, scalar, literal text, and order as UnsupportedVariant.
Bounded non-literal and empty records have distinct UnsupportedVariant and Invalid states.
Truncated, malformed, non-finite, and fourteen-number literal controls remain Invalid.
Absent, unresolved, and wrong-type transform references are separately checked.
No external or repository drawing fixture was added.
implementation.evidenceBoundary: These are generated token-shape controls, not evidence of normative SAB grammar, transform semantics, body placement, units, WCS, valid B-rep geometry, or downstream acceptance.
